status: prior - class defaults, NOT tuned on light_rocket_v2_pack_forward
provenance: control/controller.py CascadedPID attribute defaults (z-axis multirotor era). Ki_vel prior 0.15 = research/tune_gains.py CPID_BASE kiV_h (different CPID structure, prior only); added 2026-09-25 by kj decision (conditional velocity integral, paper sec 5.3).
heading: from_plant_hover_convention
design_note: Tilt limit is measured from world vertical; on this aircraft the trim thrust axis is 34.1 deg from vertical at 20 m/s, so the class cannot hold trim much above ~20 m/s. No aero feed-forward: the integrators carry the aerodynamic share of the trim (20 m/s: 4.63 m/s^2 horizontal, 2.85 m/s^2 vertical), so the arena preloads them from the controller-model trim (configs/arena.json controllers.CPID.integrator_preload). The work order limits CPID to hover and low-speed cruise.
integrator_note: Both integrators (horizontal velocity, altitude) are limited as ACCELERATION AUTHORITY in m/s^2 (1 g, as in PX4 PositionControl), independent of Ki, and are frozen while the command is tilt- or rotor-limited (paper sec 5.3 conditional integration). a_int_z_max=null restores the legacy altitude integrator (unconditional, state limit int_z_max in m*s = 2.5 m/s^2 at Ki_z 0.5).
change_record: 2026-09-26 kj decision: velocity integral limit 5 -> 9.81 m/s^2, altitude integral legacy -> 9.81 m/s^2 conditional, plus integrator preload. Made AFTER seeing the design-check result, OUTSIDE the tuning budget, in CPID's FAVOUR (baseline-strengthening direction). Recorded in the fairness table of results/ARENA_STATUS.
